definitions.ask: How much of the text height may one rendered diagram fill?
definitions.why: Planning stress tests fit H2 + two-line H3 + two pill rows; first diagram still prints at 75%

choices.label: Leaves ~130pt for heading, pills, and caption; tall diagrams print ~6% smaller than at 85%
Research-tested value with larger labels, but only ~100pt for heading, pills, and caption

definitions.ask: Should ordinary standalone Markdown images get the same height budget as Mermaid diagrams?
definitions.why: The defect and evidence are Mermaid-specific; wider scope changes layouts nobody reported

choices.label: Only Mermaid diagrams change; a tall image right after a heading can still leave a blank page
Caps every standalone image on both Markdown routes; recreated tall screenshots print smaller
